fusions.name: Scorching Pounce
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away and strikes it with your weapon, which deals 12 damage and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Tipped Lamp
fusions.desc: Swats a lit lamp at the first enemy it meets, which deals 26 damage and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. The lamp then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Unsinged
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it. You have 15% fire resistance.

fusions.name: Toying Distance
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
